Game Overview

Etano is a adventure title where guide a clever robot through the perilous world of Etano, dodging spikes, fires, and foes. Master the vital double jump to uncover hidden paths and gather golden ornaments as challenges escalate. With eight thrilling levels, keen observation and patience will be your best allies in this epic adventure.

Etano keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide a clever robot through the perilous world of Etano, dodging spikes, fires, and foes.
